description: What THIS window is doing, in one clause: your project's crew reads it in `since`. It overwrites itself; changes stay in the trail; expires. Set one when another window works your repo; a quick solo task needs none. `holds` CLAIMS work nobody else may take: a migration number, a production job or a deploy. The claim ends when you clear the line or it expires. Answers `hand` (this window's name, what `@handle:name` steers to) and `hands`, what your other windows are doing.

holds.description: Work only you may take, by key ('migration-028'); one namespace per board. Omit to keep yours.

label.description: This window's effort, one word ('auth-refactor'). Repeat it across turns.

minutes.description: How long it stays true (default 60, max 1440).

text.description: What you are doing, ≤ 120 chars. Omit to clear.

title: Say what you are doing
